name: repolink
tagline: One private repo, linked into every project.
description: Keep your research, prompts, plans, snippets, and templates in one central private repo and symlink them into every GitHub project that needs them — no copy-paste, no submodules, no hand-rolled ln -s. Mappings are committed and portable via git.

positioning.audience: developers who reuse research, prompts, and templates across many repos
positioning.wedge: surface one private repo's folders inside every project without copy-paste
